| <a id="source-as-organization-name" href="#source-as-organization-name">`source.as.organization.name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The name of the organization associated with the autonomous system of the source IP address. [3] | `Example Networks Inc.`; `Google LLC` |

**[1] `source.address`:** When observed from the destination side, and when communicating through an intermediary, `source.address` SHOULD represent the source address behind any intermediaries, for example proxies, if it's available.

**[2] `source.as.number`:** This attribute SHOULD only be set when the source address is an IP address and the ASN is available from routing, enrichment, or lookup data. The value SHOULD be represented as an integer without the `AS` prefix.

**[3] `source.as.organization.name`:** This attribute SHOULD only be set when `source.as.number` is set and the organization name is available. The value SHOULD be the organization name as provided by the lookup or enrichment source, not the AS name or short code.
